verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents core OAuth2/OIDC flows including client credentials (M2M), device authorization flow (explicitly noted as ratified OAuth 2.0), and general authentication/authorization via Universal Login and SDKs, sparing developers from implementing protocol details themselves. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit first-party documentation or quickstart specifically calling out 'authorization code with PKCE' or refresh token rotation/handling details, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of PKCE support quality. missing for 10: explicit PKCE flow documentation, refresh token rotation/handling details, independent developer corroboration of authorization-code+PKCE implementation ease.
